subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or close the open conflicting fork PR for the Debug Snapshots fix before allowing a fresh narrow fix from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open fork PR still references this issue with closing syntax and is not currently viable, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until that path is resolved.

options.title: Close fork path and queue a fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current Debug page structure before review.

recommendation.title: Close fork path and queue a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue with localized copy, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original Debug dashboard surface and is the strongest history signal for the owner-boundary decision.
